scene_full.key: Carrara Classique|warm white oak slab-front cabinets|mid-century modern|bright soft morning daylight from large windows|galley kitchen|backsplash|polished
scene_full.prompt: Bright, airy, light-filled photorealistic interior photograph of a mid-century modern kitchen, galley kitchen. The hero is the countertop: Carrara Classique quartz (soft white quartz with fine feathery grey Carrara-style veining), 3cm thick, a high-gloss polished surface with a clean eased edge, shown in full with no cropped ends or corners. The same stone runs as a full-height slab backsplash behind the range, veining flowing continuously from countertop to backsplash. Warm white oak slab-front cabinets with polished nickel hardware, bright soft morning daylight from large windows. Light walls, styled minimally (a bowl of lemons, a small vase of greenery, a cutting board). Clean bright exposure, fresh and stunning, uncluttered, real materials and true-to-life reflections, eye-level architectural photography, 24-35mm lens, magazine quality. Tall vertical 9:16 composition: the stone surface sits in the vertical middle of the frame and spans no more than 85% of the width, with generous space above and below, so the image can also be cropped to 4:5 and 1:1 around it. Quiet, low-detail upper corners. No people, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
